title: User-generated media moderation
summary: Uploads arrive by API: AI safety analysis of images and videos, threshold rules that auto-approve or reject clear cases, a moderator queue for the rest, and the uploader is told.
description:
User-generated media moderation starts when your site or app posts an upload to the workflow: its id, a download URL, whether it is an image or a video, the uploader and the caption.

Analyze Image (or Analyze Video for clips) describes the upload and answers a structured moderation question: a risk score from 0 to 1, the top category (nudity, violence, hate, harassment, self-harm, drugs, weapons, spam), a possible child safety concern, whether people are visible and a one-sentence reason. The Moderation thresholds decision table auto-approves low risk, auto-rejects high risk and sends borderline items, self-harm and any child safety concern to a person.

Moderators get a task with the AI reason clearly marked as a triage aid and approve or reject with the guideline that applies. Your platform is called to publish or hide the upload (placeholder REST API), the uploader is emailed with how to appeal, and every decision is logged with a one-year retention policy.
start: Headless: your platform calls the start API (or an inbound webhook) for each new upload.
setup: Google Gemini (media AI): paste your Gemini API key. (For image safety categories from a moderation endpoint, add an OpenAI or AWS integration and choose it on Analyze Image with the Safety feature.)
Content platform: set the base URL and token of the API that publishes and hides uploads, and adjust the Publish upload / Reject upload paths.
Assignees: pick the moderator (escalates to their manager after 8 hours).
Tune the Moderation thresholds to your guidelines. Route possible child safety issues to your legal reporting process: this package only queues them for a person.
Create an inbound webhook (or call the start API) from your platform for each upload; media URLs must be reachable from UserTasks.

steps.title: Upload received
steps.body: Your platform posts the upload id, media URL and type, uploader and caption.

steps.title: AI safety analysis
steps.body: Analyze Image or Analyze Video returns a description and a structured verdict: risk score, category, child safety concern, people visible, reason.

steps.title: Thresholds
steps.body: The Moderation thresholds decision table approves low risk, rejects high risk and queues the rest for a person.

steps.title: Moderator queue
steps.body: Borderline uploads become tasks: the moderator approves, or rejects with the guideline.

steps.title: Publish or hide
steps.body: The platform API publishes or hides the upload and the uploader is emailed (with how to appeal).

steps.title: Log
steps.body: Every check and decision is logged with who decided and why, under a one-year retention policy.
